ue_landscape.world_z_note: World Z (cm) = elevation_m * 100 - 0 (absolute ASL in cm); slices/buildings must use the same.

method: Copernicus GLO-30 DSM; Overture footprints + residual>4 m masked; Laplace fill; gaussian 1.5; DTM<=DSM; core slope softened; bicubic to 1 m.
source: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 (c) DLR e.V. 2010-2014 and (c) Airbus Defence and Space GmbH 2014-2018, provided under COPERNICUS by the EU and ESA. Footprints: Overture Maps (ODbL / CC BY 4.0).
